Sand Calculator

Sand calculator for paver bedding, sandboxes and fill: length, width and depth to cubic yards, tons and bags.

Sand weight and volume

Dry sand weighs about 100 lb per cubic foot, or roughly 1.35 tons per cubic yard; wet sand can be 1.5+ tons per yard. Volume = L × W × depth(in) ÷ 12, then ÷ 27 for cubic yards.

Example: a 10 × 10 ft area at 2 in = 16.67 cu ft = 0.62 cu yd ≈ 0.83 tons ≈ 34 bags of 50 lb.

Which sand?

  • Concrete/coarse sand: paver bedding layer
  • Polymeric sand: paver joints
  • Play sand: washed, screened sandboxes
  • Mason sand: mortar and smooth finish work
